_comment: Trail Mix route. 8 chapters, 7 physical stops. Transition chapters have no QR code and no archive stop. Stop ids are the URL slugs at /trail/{id}/ and must never change once printed. Munkebotn was added 2026-08-22, promoted from the earlier city-releases-you transition — a real valley the route already walked through, now a real stop rather than pure scenery.
title: Trail Mix
subtitle: Mount Media × Preem Cast
core_promise: A moving cultural performance where music, local history, ecological attention and collective care travel through Bergen together.

real_route._comment: Not modelled or estimated — captured directly from Google Maps walking directions by Ingrid Ormevik and reported here as she read it off the screen, same tier of trust as a human pasting a live page's own content elsewhere in this project.

stops.folklore_ban_reason: Chapter theme is MEMORY and institutional history. Casting any being here produces the asylum-horror trope the spec bans. Enforced in code, not left to judgement.
